title: Movie soundtracks and how they pay
summary: Edison played on film soundtracks such as Houseboat for Nelson Riddle and compares pay for movie and record dates.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Oh, yes. And Dave Klein he's the one that -- and I made the soundtrack for a lot of the movies, "Step Down to Terror" with Richard -- Anthony Quinn. And I made the soundtrack for "Houseboat" with Cary Grant and Sophia Loren. Jane Powell, the girl most likely -- Nelson Riddle scored all the music for that.
Did you appear in any of these?
How does that soundtrack work? How does that pay as compared with records?
Well, it's comparatively the same only you have to work longer hours to make -- the record date is three hours, you see. And I think a movie call is four or something.
Oh, but more or less the same money?
Yes, about the same money. Unless you double, you know, you go overtime, which is good. But if you get enough of them in a week, record dates, I used to do two,
